case_title: Online Furniture Purchase and Non-Delivery Complaint

expected_checklist.reason: The online payment receipt and order confirmation are available.
The case does not mention whether a warranty document was supplied.
The claimant's customer complaint is available.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: The tracking page says delivered, but there is no independent proof of physical handover.

expected_defects.description: The tracking page shows delivery, while the claimant denies receiving the furniture.
There is no recipient signature, OTP record or other proof confirming who accepted the package.

expected_review.reason: The warranty document is unclear and the delivery confirmation evidence is incomplete.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain delivery partner records and recipient confirmation before assessing the non-delivery complaint.

testing_notes: Do not treat a tracking status alone as conclusive proof of delivery.
Compare the claimant's account with the seller's and delivery partner's records.
